purpose: Forensic recovery and verification of all legacy Multiversal source material.
verificationRules: A finding may not be marked verified without a registered source and page locator.
A canonical match must preserve the stable object ID.
Conflicts, duplicates, and aliases require an explicit review decision.
Automated matching is advisory and cannot grant canonical approval.
A source is complete only when every page is audited and all findings are resolved or explicitly deferred.

authorityBoundaries.humanReview: Required for verification, conflict resolution, and canon approval.
